body:
delete-openshift-vm.sh now drains in-flight jobs before tearing down the VM, with --no-drain as an escape hatch. Fleet VMs (RUNNER_TOKEN set, or no proj/vm runner match) skip deregistration and no longer require GL_TOKEN.

---

Closes #7257
